audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim festival, judge, and anti-cult-object law, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Passover, Unleavened Bread, Weeks, Booths, chosen-place pilgrimage, inclusive rejoicing, festival gifts, local judges, impartial justice, bribery, justice pursuit, Asherah, and pillar prohibitions.

verses.restored: Guard month of Aviv and make Passover to YHWH your Divine, for in month of Aviv YHWH your Divine brought you out from Egypt by night.

familiar.text: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

modern.text: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

original.text: שָׁמוֹר֙ אֶת חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֔יב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֞י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֗יב הוֹצִ֨יאֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לָֽיְלָה

verses.restored: You shall sacrifice Passover to YHWH your Divine from flock and herd, in place YHWH chooses to cause his name to dwell.

familiar.text: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

modern.text: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name.

original.text: וְזָבַ֥חְתָּ פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֑ר בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם

verses.restored: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, bread of affliction, for in haste you came out from land of Egypt, so you may remember day of your coming out from land of Egypt all days of your life.

familiar.text: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

modern.text: You must not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt.

original.text: לֹא תֹאכַ֤ל עָלָיו֙ חָמֵ֔ץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים תֹּֽאכַל עָלָ֥יו מַצּ֖וֹת לֶ֣חֶם עֹ֑נִי כִּ֣י בְחִפָּז֗וֹן יָצָ֨אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכֹּר֔ אֶת י֤וֹם צֵֽאתְךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ

verses.restored: No leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory seven days, and none of flesh you sacrifice in evening on first day shall remain overnight until morning.

familiar.text: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

modern.text: No leaven is to be found in all your land for seven days, and none of the meat you sacrifice in the evening of the first day shall remain until morning.

original.text: וְלֹֽא יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֥ שְׂאֹ֛ר בְּכָל גְּבֻלְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא יָלִ֣ין מִן הַבָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּעֶ֛רֶב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לַבֹּֽקֶר

verses.restored: You may not sacrifice Passover within any of your gates YHWH your Divine gives you,

familiar.text: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

modern.text: You are not to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you.

original.text: לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִזְבֹּ֣חַ אֶת הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: but at place YHWH your Divine chooses to cause his name to dwell, there you shall sacrifice Passover in evening at going down of sun, appointed time of your coming out from Egypt.

familiar.text: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

modern.text: You must only offer the Passover sacrifice at the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name. Do this in the evening as the sun sets, at the same time you departed from Egypt.

original.text: כִּ֠י אִֽם אֶל הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֔וֹ שָׁ֛ם תִּזְבַּ֥ח אֶת הַפֶּ֖סַח בָּעָ֑רֶב כְּב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מוֹעֵ֖ד צֵֽאתְךָ֥ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: You shall cook and eat it in place YHWH your Divine chooses; in morning you shall turn and go to your tents.

familiar.text: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

modern.text: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place the LORD your God will choose, and in the morning you shall return to your tents.

original.text: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֙ וְאָ֣כַלְתָּ֔ בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ וּפָנִ֣יתָ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ לְאֹהָלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on seventh day solemn assembly to YHWH your Divine; you shall do no work.

familiar.text: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.

modern.text: For six days you must eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God, and you must not do any work. The Feast of Weeks (Numbers 28:26–31)

original.text: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצּ֑וֹת וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י עֲצֶ֨רֶת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מְלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: Seven weeks you shall count for yourself; from beginning of sickle in standing grain begin to count seven weeks.

familiar.text: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

modern.text: You are to count off seven weeks from the time you first put the sickle to the standing grain.

original.text: שִׁבְעָ֥ה שָׁבֻעֹ֖ת תִּסְפָּר לָ֑ךְ מֵהָחֵ֤ל חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ בַּקָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל לִסְפֹּ֔ר שִׁבְעָ֖ה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת

verses.restored: You shall make Festival of Weeks to YHWH your Divine with measure of freewill gift of your hand that you give, according to how YHWH your Divine blesses you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

modern.text: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מִסַּ֛ת נִדְבַ֥ת יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall rejoice before YHWH your Divine—you, your son, daughter, male servant, female servant, Levite within your gates, and sojourner, orphan, and widow in your midst—at place YHWH your Divine chooses to cause his name to dwell.

familiar.text: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

modern.text: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.

original.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבִתֶּךָ֮ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶךָ֒ וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ בַּמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם

verses.restored: You shall remember you were a slave in Egypt and keep and do these statutes.

familiar.text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

modern.text: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes. The Feast of Tabernacles (Numbers 29:12–40)

original.text: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Festival of Booths you shall make for yourself seven days, when you gather from threshing floor and winepress.

familiar.text: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

modern.text: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

original.text: חַ֧ג הַסֻּכֹּ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בְּאָ֨סְפְּךָ֔ מִֽגָּרְנְךָ֖ וּמִיִּקְבֶֽךָ

verses.restored: You shall rejoice in your festival—you, your son, daughter, male servant, female servant, Levite, sojourner, orphan, and widow within your gates.

familiar.text: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

modern.text: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.

original.text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ בְּחַגֶּ֑ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֨ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֗י וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Seven days you shall celebrate to YHWH your Divine in place YHWH chooses, for YHWH your Divine will bless you in all your produce and all work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

familiar.text: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

modern.text: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.

original.text: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תָּחֹג֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י יְבָרֶכְךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹ֤ל תְּבוּאָֽתְךָ֙ וּבְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔יךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ אַ֥ךְ שָׂמֵֽחַ

verses.restored: Three times in year every male of yours shall appear before YHWH your Divine in place he chooses: at Festival of Unleavened Bread, Festival of Weeks, and Festival of Booths; and he shall not appear before YHWH empty.

familiar.text: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

modern.text: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed.

original.text: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כָל זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם

verses.restored: Each man according to gift of his hand, according to blessing YHWH your Divine gave you.

familiar.text: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.

modern.text: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Judges and Justice

original.text: אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Judges and officers you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates YHWH your Divine gives you, tribe by tribe; they shall judge people with righteous judgment.

familiar.text: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

modern.text: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.

original.text: שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְשֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים תִּֽתֶּן לְךָ֙ בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לִשְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת הָעָ֖ם מִשְׁפַּט צֶֽדֶק

verses.restored: You shall not bend judgment; you shall not recognize faces/show partiality, and you shall not take bribe, for bribe blinds eyes of wise and twists words of righteous.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

modern.text: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

original.text: לֹא תַטֶּ֣ה מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹ֥א תַכִּ֖יר פָּנִ֑ים וְלֹא תִקַּ֣ח שֹׁ֔חַד כִּ֣י הַשֹּׁ֗חַד יְעַוֵּר֙ עֵינֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽם

verses.restored: Justice, justice you shall pursue, so you may live and possess land YHWH your Divine gives you.

familiar.text: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

modern.text: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you. Forbidden Forms of Worship

original.text: צֶ֥דֶק צֶ֖דֶק תִּרְדֹּ֑ף לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיֶה֙ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah of any tree beside altar of YHWH your Divine that you make for yourself.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

modern.text: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,

original.text: לֹֽא תִטַּ֥ע לְךָ֛ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה כָּל עֵ֑ץ אֵ֗צֶל מִזְבַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: You shall not raise for yourself a pillar, which YHWH your Divine hates.

familiar.text: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

modern.text: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.

original.text: וְלֹֽא תָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מַצֵּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

translation_notes: The three pilgrimage festivals remain living Jewish sacred times and must not be superseded or detached from Jewish practice.
Passover memory centers hurried liberation and bread of affliction.
Festival joy repeatedly includes servants, Levites, immigrants, orphans, and widows; sacred celebration is socially incomplete without vulnerable neighbors.
Festival giving is proportionate to blessing rather than a flat burden.
Judges are local, tribal, and bound by impartiality and anti-bribery law.
'Justice, justice you shall pursue' makes justice active, repeated, and life-directed.
Asherah and pillar restrictions are ancient Israelite cult law and cannot justify modern destruction of other religions' sacred objects.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 16 to appropriate Jewish festivals, exclude vulnerable people from religious celebration, corrupt courts through wealth or status, or destroy another community's sacred symbols. Center liberation memory, inclusive joy, proportionate giving, and relentless pursuit of justice.
